task1031_prs.body: Reduction of L-meta-1031, one file, one theorem. Statement copied verbatim from the desk row. Cut into two smaller statements: h1, on a triangle-free, 4-cycle-free graph, a least fan-in-two AND/OR circuit for the edge function exists and has the EdgeOwnership star profile; h2, such a star-profile circuit satisfies the inline ownership condition of the recorded statement.
